Usage: pty events [--all | <ref>] [--recent [--type <type>]] [--json] [--wait <type>] [-t <sec>]

Follow a session's event log (bell, title, notifications, tag/rename changes, user.* events).

Flags:
  --all                Follow every session, interleaved (omit <ref>)
  --recent             Print recent events and exit (don't follow)
  --json               Emit raw JSONL
  --type <type>         With --recent, print every retained event of this exact type
  --wait <type>        Block until an event of <type> appears
  -t, --timeout <sec>  Timeout (seconds) for --wait or follow; exit 1 on timeout

Options may appear before or after <ref>. A named follow exits when the session
exits or its registry entry is removed; --all continues watching new sessions.
--wait exits 1 if the session ends before a matching event, or on timeout.

Examples:
  pty events myserver
  pty events --recent --json myserver
  pty events --recent --json --type user.tests-passed myserver
